1939-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1939-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

5078-6650-6965-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-6965-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-5256-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5256-7920.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
728-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

654-2557-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1479-3478-5362.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

206-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3963-4377-7722.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-4377-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Meneldor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
647-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

913-2440-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Eldrazi and Spawn you control.
If needed, activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Repeat.
913-2440-5685.notes: You should only perform step 3 if you have no {G} available. The initial mana cost can be reduced if you control additional Eldrazi and/or Spawns.

997-1116-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-1116-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Sek'Kuar and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2781-4050-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1409-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

1385-4681-5170-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2921-5220-6539-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-851-1270-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1270-4365.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1074-4222-4289.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

4112-6767-6798.description:
Cast Rescue Skiff by paying {5}{W}.
When Rescue Skiff enter the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sharuum.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Rescue Skiff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-3743-5014-5089-6753.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5014-5089-6753.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

624-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phantasmal Image
624-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Phantasmal Image's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Phantasmal Image's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

856-1477-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

275-1799-2034-5359.description:
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1253-4824-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1253-4824-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Gyre Engineer's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1170-4124-4826-5921-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-3542-4124.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {G}{G}.
1170-3542-4124.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Whip Silk by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1601-1651-1799-2455-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Grenzo has power 4 or greater.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1651-1799-2455-4840.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding seven {B}.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Myr Battlesphere on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Myr Battlesphere and a Myr token, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

215-729-2404-2872.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-2404-2872.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Clever Conjurer any number of times.

692-2034-4613-5086.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-2034-4613-5086.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Triskelavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
When the Triskelavite enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Triskelavites, or activate their own abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least two +1/+1 counters on it

276-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
276-3693-4120.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

238-2506-4050.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
238-2506-4050.description:
Cast Gerrard either from your graveyard or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gerrard enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Gerrard with haste.
Put the nontoken Gerrard into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The nontoken Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
The token Gerrard dies, exiling itself and returning the nontoken Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1980-2556-2596.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1980-2556-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Living Death.
Resolve the copy of Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Resolve Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Mnemonic Wall and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1283-2430-2670-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
1283-2430-2670-3075.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Petals of Insight by paying at most {4}.
If you have less than five experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Holding priority, activate Psychic Puppetry's splice ability by paying {1} and revealing it from your hand, adding Psychic Puppetry's effects to Petals of Insight.
Resolve Petals of Insight, looking at the top three cards of your library, putting them on the bottom of your library, untapping Chromatic Orrery, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2580-2830-5141.description:
Cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Activate Lethal Vapors an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}: until your next turn your life total can't change and you have protection from everything.
Allow all the activated abilities from Lethal Vapors to resolve, skipping an arbitrarily large number of turns.

2050-4222-5227.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to a Forest you control.
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
2050-4222-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
2050-4222-5227.description:
Activate the Forest Utopia Sprawl is attached to by tapping it, adding {G} or any color it can produce.
Utopia Sprawl's last ability triggers, adding {U}
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the Forest.
Activate the Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.

2120-2506.notablePrerequisites:
"Wizard" or "Merfolk" chosen with Molten Echoes.
An opponent cannot block your creature.
2120-2506.description:
Cast Wanderwine Prophets by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Wanderwine Prophets's Champion a Merfolk ability and Molten Echoes's ability trigger.
Resolve Molten Echoes's ability, creating a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets with haste.
The token Wanderwine Prophets triggers, exiling the original Wanderwine Prophets until the token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the remaining Champion a Merfolk ability, declining to exile anything.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the token Wanderwine Prophets.
The token Wanderwine Prophets triggers, allowing you to sacrifice it to take an extra turn.
The token's Champion a Merfolk ability returns the original Wanderwine Prophets from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, exile the new token copy of Wanderwine Prophets.
The token's Champion a Merfolk ability returns the original Wanderwine Prophets from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 6 each turn.

618-2075.description:
Activate the mutated Glowstone Recluse and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.
